what_happened: Recovered the prior Gate-8-parallelization task's exact deployed-vs-source measurement methodology (grep -l '$REPO_ROOT/.claude' *.sh) and re-ran it: 52/91 today vs 41/73 originally, a stable ~56-57% ratio and core-only (0 hits in other extensions). Also found script-inventory.sh's has_test has an undocumented directory-resolution bug for lib/ and lint/ candidates, and identified a concrete 18-script zero-reference set to use as the fail-safe test fixture.

Research report pre-settled the flag shape, the single filtering site, the three-strata mapping and the real 18-script fail-safe fixture with re-runnable measurement commands, so the plan needed only re-derivation of counts rather than fresh investigation; plan passed validate-artifact.sh --strict with zero warnings on first write.

Phase 1 baseline full-sweep measurements (--jobs 1: ~21.3min, --jobs auto: ~11.2min) ran far slower than shell-script-testing.md's previously recorded loaded baseline (14min/6m47s) due to unusually heavy concurrent sibling dispatch load (uptime load average rose from 3.99 to 8.03 during the measurement window). 5 suites failed identically in both runs, plausibly load-sensitive artifacts of this measurement session rather than defects; recorded with full load-condition context in Phase 1 notes.

A concurrent sibling task added 3 of its own manifest.json provides.scripts entries (lib/phase-heartbeat-lib.sh, tests/test-lint-agent-contracts-heartbeat.sh, tests/test-task-lock-liveness.sh) to the same shared file while this task needed to add its own single entry (lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) in response to a Gate 3 doc-lint finding during Phase 5 acceptance testing. Since git-commit-scoped.sh's git add always re-reads the full working-tree file content (no partial-hunk staging), committing the pathspec directly would have swept the sibling's uncommitted work into this task's commit. Resolved by temporarily removing the sibling's 3 lines from the working tree, committing cleanly with only this task's own hunk, then restoring the sibling's lines back into the uncommitted working tree exactly as they were -- verified via diff against the pre-edit snapshot. No sibling work was lost or misattributed.

Task 366's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
